required_outcomes: Recognises the tenant's email at event 021 as a repeat of the same open dishwasher door job, not a new fault.
Replies to the tenant with the existing booking: Riverside Compliance is due tomorrow, Wednesday 29/04/2026 between 8 and 12, with the provider's contact number for changes.
Adds a note to the existing job that the tenant chased on 28/04 and was given the booking details, and otherwise leaves the case as it is.
acceptable_alternatives: Also sending the provider a one-line reminder that the tenant is expecting them tomorrow, without changing the booking.
Replying by SMS instead of email, as long as the date, time window and provider name are given.
positive_behaviours: Keeps the reply short and does not ask the tenant to repeat information already on file.
States plainly in the reasoning that no new ticket, provider or appointment is needed.
Checks the open ticket before replying rather than relying on the email alone.
red_flags: Asks the tenant to describe the fault again or to run the troubleshooting checks from event 005 again.
Changes or cancels the confirmed appointment.
prohibited_actions: Creating a new ticket or request for the dishwasher door.
Assigning a second provider or asking the landlord for approval again.
critical_failures: Creating a second job or assigning another provider for the same open fault.
